plugins.name: deepseek-supervisor
plugins.description: A supervisor for Claude Code on a weaker model such as DeepSeek: rules on what the model ran catch circles, bent tests and claims the record contradicts; a second, stronger model runs its claims and reviews its changes; what does not hold goes back to the model before the turn ends
